description.content: This endpoint is used to create a VoPay account. You will need to sign-up as a partner account in order to use this endpoint and start creating VoPay accounts for your users.

urlencoded.description: (Required) Your account ID
(Required) API key for the account
(Required) Hashed signature for the request
(Required) Name of the person/company you are going to create an account for
(Required) Email address of the person/company you are creating an account for
This is an opetional parameter specifying the country of the account. ISO abbreviation or full country name. If not provided, the account will inherit the country of the partner account.
This is an optional parameter to enable client accounts
Specify the parent account ID to create a sub account under this parent account
It is a flag to allow user to decide if he wants to create a virtual account for the subaccount. By default this value is set as false. Must have VirtualAccounts enabled to use this parameter.
Optional custom account ID to assign to the new account being created
Full name of the primary contact for the account
Street address line 1 for the account
Street address line 2 for the account
City of the account address
Province or state of the account address
Postal or ZIP code of the account address

description.content:
This endpoint will transfer money from the debitor account to the recipient account, and then immediately withdraw the money from the recipient account into their default bank account.

To set a default bank account, please use the /bank-account/set-my-bank-account endpoint.

description.content:
This endpoint will fund the debitor account using their default bank account, and then transfer the money to the recipient account once the funds have been cleared. Once the funds are transferred, a withdraw transaction will be triggered to send the funds to the recipient account's default bank account.

To set a default bank account, please use the /bank-account/set-my-bank-account endpoint.
